Buy a Polish ID Card on Telegram

The Polish id card is issued by the gmina. Every real one carries marks from that office and a seller who cannot point to them is guessing. This page is a checklist for that conversation.

Issuing authority
the gmina
Observed price band
280–1000 PLN
Typical delivery
3 to 21 days, tracked
Local name
dowod osobisty
Document type
An ID card is a domestic identity document issued by a civil registry, police force or municipal office. It proves identity inside the country and usually nothing outside it.

buy polish id card on telegram – the short version

Nothing about Telegram makes a Polish id card more likely to be fake. It is a shop window with no returns policy, which is why the checks matter more here than they would at a counter.

Everything here assumes the seller is a stranger and the money is not reversible. That is the normal condition on Telegram and it is why the process later on is staged rather than a single transfer.

Buy a ID Card via Telegram: how the transaction works

Delivery is where most Polish id card deals go quiet. Insist on a tracking number inside forty eight hours and treat a seller who only offers a photo of an envelope as unproven.

Do not send the balance against a promise of a tracking number. Send it against the number itself, checked on the carrier site rather than on a screenshot.

Who actually issues a ID Card

Every feature on a Polish id card exists because the gmina put it there: substrate, print method, UV ink, number format. Strip those out and what is left is a picture of a card.

Finally, remember the office never contacts you. Any message claiming to be from the gmina confirming your purchase is a second party, usually the seller, and worth exactly as much as their word.

Replica or registered original

The middle tier is stock. The seller has real blank or cancelled stock of the right type and prints onto it, so the physical layer is genuine and the number is invented. Most adverts at the middle of the band are this.

Some sellers will not send a number before a deposit. That is a reasonable position, but the deposit should be small and the number should follow immediately after it.

What a fair price looks like

Prices move with the document own difficulty. A card with a chip and a UV layer costs more to produce than a laminate print and the advert should reflect that.

Replacement terms are the other hidden line. A seller who replaces a failed parcel prices higher and is usually worth the premium, but only after a track record long enough to make the promise mean something.

The buying process, step by step

Work through these in order. Each step exists because it is where a bad Polish id card deal usually breaks.

  1. Ask which office issued it and confirm the answer is the gmina.
  2. Request an uncropped photo of the full card on a plain surface with the laminate edge in frame.
  3. Request a UV shot of the data page and a close crop of the number field.
  4. Test the number against the format the gmina uses. A number that breaks the format ends the deal.
  5. Agree a price inside the 280–1000 PLN band and pay in two parts, deposit then balance against tracking.
  6. On arrival check the document against the photos before you accept delivery and photograph the unopened envelope.

Checks that catch bad stock

The five checks below take minutes and catch almost everything. Two of them are specific to Poland.

  • Check the licence for the Polish category layout and the starosta issuing reference.
  • Confirm the identity card machine-readable zone and the PESEL weighted checksum.
  • Check the number format against the published rule for the gmina. Constructed numbers cannot be invented by hand.
  • Look for the UV print with a 365 nanometre torch. Real ink is sharp and placed deliberately. A print shows a dull bloom or nothing.
  • Loupe the microprint and the ghost image. Both collapse into a dotted line or a grey patch on a photocopy.
  • Compare the data across every field for internal consistency. A postcode that contradicts the state or the office area is a tell.
  • Check the laminate or polycarbonate edge for a fused seal rather than a cut line under a laid sheet.

Red flags that should end the conversation

If you see any of these, stop paying attention to the price.

  • A document with a PESEL that fails the weighted sum check.
  • The seller cannot name the issuing office, only the country.
  • The number breaks the published format, or is round and repeating.

Frequently asked questions

How much is an ID card on Telegram?

Between 90 and 500 US dollars. A print sits at the bottom, a chip card with a valid number at the top.

Is an ID card worth buying at all?

It is the cheapest document to fake convincingly, so it is also the one most often faked badly. Buy it only with a number check.

Do ID cards work abroad?

Inside the issuing country, yes. Outside it, most are only accepted as secondary evidence.

What is the giveaway on a fake ID?

The number. It is the one part that has to obey a rule, and sellers who invent numbers rarely know the rule.

Can I check an ID number myself?

In most countries yes, because the algorithm is published. Search for the country name and check digit.

Before you pay

If you have a Polish id card in front of you and something feels off, compare it against the list above before you send anything.
